name: handoff-compact
description: Replaces Claude Code's compaction with a structured handoff: a fork of the session writes it from the prompt cache, and the conversation continues from exactly that handoff.

threshold.title: Threshold (%)
threshold.description: Compact once the context fills this share of the compact window.

window.title: Compact window (tokens)
window.description: 0 = automatic: adapter, then CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW, then autoCompactWindow in settings.json, then the model's context window.

keepVerbatim.title: Verbatim prompts/answers
keepVerbatim.description: How many of the latest user prompts and assistant answers go into the handoff word for word.

autoContinue.title: Continue after compacting
autoContinue.description: never | always | adapter (the adapter decides per session). Applies to compactions this mod starts itself.

precompute.title: Claude Code's background pre-compaction
precompute.description: skip = turn it off (saves the tokens of a summary this mod replaces anyway) | core = leave it on.

handoffDir.title: Handoff directory
handoffDir.description: Where each handoff is saved as a Markdown file. Empty = ~/.claude/handoffs.

outlineFile.title: Outline file
outlineFile.description: A text file with the sections every handoff must have, one per line. Empty = the built-in nine-point outline.

adapter.title: Adapter command
adapter.description: Optional executable that tells the mod about your setup (window, state files, whether to continue). Protocol in README.md.
